fable_scanner\\examples\\agent_config.js.why: A claude-fable-5 call with no `fallbacks` dead-ends on refusal: HTTP 200, stop_reason=refusal, empty content, and nothing recovers it.
temperature/top_p/top_k are not supported on Fable 5 -- the API returns 400.
Manual `thinking: {type: "enabled", budget_tokens: N}` is rejected on Fable 5. Thinking is always on; control depth with output_config.effort.

fable_scanner\\examples\\bad_prompt.md.why: IMPORTANT/CRITICAL/WARNING framing compensated for weaker instruction following on older models. Fable 5 gives the same weight to a plain sentence.
Asking Fable 5 to echo its internal reasoning as response text is a documented `reasoning_extraction` refusal trigger. Use adaptive thinking instead of narrating it in the output.
12+ enumerated behavior items suggests a skill written for a weaker model. Fable 5 follows a brief intent statement better than a long list.
"YOU MUST" / "YOU MUST NOT" shouting. State the constraint plainly.
Surfacing a remaining-token countdown makes Fable 5 wrap up early. Never show the model its own context budget.
